user.title: Connect wFirma
user.description: In wFirma, open Settings → Security and create API keys: you get an access key and a secret key. The app key is issued by wFirma when you request API access.

company.title: Choose the company
company.description: These keys can open several companies. Pick the one to follow; add the integration again for another.

reauth_confirm.title: New wFirma keys
reauth_confirm.description: wFirma no longer accepts the keys for {company}. Enter new ones.

error.invalid_auth: wFirma rejected these keys, or they cannot open this company.
error.cannot_connect: wFirma could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
error.rate_limited: wFirma asked to slow down. Wait 5 minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This wFirma company is already set up.
